text: When you loop over a list, you often need the position as well as the value — and enumerate gives you both.
It hands back a pair each time: the index first, then the item.
So instead of tracking a counter yourself, enumerate does it automatically as you loop.
[chuckle] By default it counts from zero, but you can pass start equals one to number things naturally.
That's perfect for ranked lists, turning your loop into a clean, numbered display.
[sniff] Compare it to the old way — a separate index variable you increment by hand, easy to forget.
Here enumerate lets us flag exactly which item needs review, by its position.
[groan] Any time you catch yourself writing i equals zero and i plus equals one around a loop, reach for enumerate instead.
In the next one we take on zip. Tell me in the comments if this clicked.
